## Obtain Data

```{r}
data <- mtcars
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r}
summary(data$mpg)
```

## Density

```{r}
# plot(density(data$mpg))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = data, aes(x = mpg)) +
  geom_density()
```



```{r}
mean(data$mpg)
median(data$mpg)
```

Right Skew

## Scatterplot

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = data,
  aes(x = cyl, y = mpg)
) +
  geom_point()
```

## Boxplot

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = mtcars,
  aes(x = cyl, y = mpg, group = cyl)
) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

```{r}
x <- 2
```

x is `r x`
